reply_body:
Hello Esko,

Thanks for letting us know about booking RB-20265093.

Our policy is that the damage deposit is only forfeited if a rental is returned more than seven calendar days late, or with damage or missing parts. Five days late doesn't reach that threshold, so as long as the scissor lift itself came back complete and undamaged, the full €150 deposit will be refunded within five working days of check-in.

One thing I do need to flag: a late return fee still applies for the five days, charged at the standard daily rate for each day past the agreed end date. That's separate from the deposit and isn't something we're able to waive for this booking - weather, traffic, and site delays don't change that under our policy.

The earlier deposit issue was resolved in your favour because a fault with the equipment itself was confirmed - that's a different situation from this one, where the issue is the late return rather than a fault, so the same reasoning doesn't carry over to the late fee. The deposit itself is unaffected either way and will still come back to you in full.

Let me know if you have any questions about the late fee.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service

Clarified that the earlier goodwill resolution was based on a confirmed equipment fault, which does not apply to this late-return situation
